name: Hero's Wings
text:
Your wings have grown to their full, majestic form, granting you the unlimited power of flight. You have a fly Speed of 25 feet at all times.

Furthermore, sprites recognize you as a powerful hero (or villain) by your unique wings and are appropriately impressed. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all Diplomacy and Intimidation checks against sprites and gain the benefits of the Glad-Hand skill feat against other sprites.
